title: Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd - 533155 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Jubilant FoodWorks Q2 FY27: gross margin improving via pricing and mix, but Popeyes store margins lag and Turkey LFL stays negative.
summary.overview: Management said pricing of about 140-200 bps has been taken so far, with further hikes possible if inflation persists. Q2 was the first quarter of overall revenue growth at DITA (Domino's dine-in/takeaway), with average daily sales decline arrested rather than reversed. Management said Domino's absorbed about 140 bps of roughly 200 bps unplanned cost hit, leaving about 60 bps outstanding. Popeyes has about 100 stores, with a plan to reach roughly 250 stores (Rs 1,000 crore run rate), though guidance remains 40-45 openings per year. The call contained no quantitative financial figures beyond these comments, and the transcript did not give Q2 revenue, EBITDA or margin numbers.

financial_highlights.metric: Popeyes gross margin upside still targeted
financial_highlights.value: about 200 bps (another 100-200 bps cited in a later answer)
almost double-digit over last year (no exact figure)

segments.name: Domino's India
segments.commentary: Q2 was the first quarter of overall revenue growth at DITA, and average daily sales decline has been arrested. Management plans full-year LFL of 5-7%, with Q3 planned in that range. Store refurbishment covers about 400 stores, with about 100 done and completion expected in about three quarters.

segments.name: Popeyes
segments.commentary: About 100 stores in 25 cities, with guidance of 40-45 openings. Store-level margins still lag because unit economics need work on rentals, store operating costs, manpower and marketing. Gross margin has another 100-200 bps of upside, and ADS target is near Rs 1 lakh per store.

segments.name: Hong's Kitchen and Popeyes (emerging brands)
segments.commentary: Management said drag from emerging brands was reduced ahead of plan, against a 100 bps target. Hong's and Popeyes were named together.

segments.name: Turkey (Coffy and Domino's Turkey)
segments.commentary: Reported LFL is negative even though Domino's average order growth per store is positive and prices are ahead of inflation. Management attributed the gap to the accounting method for headline inflation. Coffy is repositioning toward value, university-adjacent stores, loyalty and a cold-beverage portfolio.

guidance_outlook: Full-year LFL (same-store sales growth) targeted at 5-7%, with Q3 planned in that range; the next 7-10 days and the Christmas period could move the number by 100-200 bps.
Gross margin: a further 200 bps improvement is targeted, and the 200 bps expansion plan is about 60 bps short after absorbing unplanned costs.
Popeyes openings guided at about 40-45 stores; management says faster openings depend on suitable locations and unit economics.
Further price increases will be taken if required to mitigate inflation in dairy, chicken and vegetables; the West Asia crisis and monsoon are cited as drivers.
Cheese supply is covered for the current financial year.
capex_capacity: Store refurbishment (front-of-house, furniture, paint) covers about 400 stores, with about 100 completed; target completion is about three quarters from the call.
Popeyes: about 100 stores; plan is to reach 250 stores and a Rs 1,000 crore run rate, with the next 150 stores mapped geography by geography.
Management said Popeyes is not capital-constrained; openings are paced by real estate availability and backend supply chain build-out.
Co-located Domino's and Popeyes food-court style stores are opportunistic (about 3-4 sites); management has not yet decided to scale them.
demand_pricing: Pricing: about 140-150 to 200 bps of price increases taken, calibrated through machine-learning models, using day parts and channels rather than blanket increases.
Inflation: dairy/milk prices rising sharply, with a timing lag in cheese; chicken and vegetables also inflating due to monsoon and West Asia-driven costs.
Customer acquisition: MAU is growing about 25% versus about 9% growth in MTU, which management attributed to under-penetrated online delivery; Nielsen data shows market share gains.
Innovation: Cheese Burst range, Chicken Maxxx, Paneer Maxxx, Cold Coffee and Mousse Cakes are driving mix; management says innovation adds almost double-digit contribution to top-line growth.
Demand: management said it cannot read India-wide consumption from a ~2,500-2,600 store, fully urban network, and pressure is seen more in inflation than in demand.

qa_highlights.question: What is the quantum of price increases taken, and is a further hike required given cheese inflation?
qa_highlights.answer: About 140-150 to 200 bps of calibrated price increases taken so far, with further hikes possible. Cheese supply is covered for this financial year, but dairy inflation is coming through in milk prices.

qa_highlights.question: Is the full year LFL 5-7% or the exit rate?
qa_highlights.answer: Management planned a full-year LFL of 5-7%, with Q3 planned within that range. It did not give a second-half figure.

qa_highlights.question: Why do MAU growth (about 25%) and MTU growth (about 9%) diverge?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said new customers are being acquired through revised digital marketing. Conversion of new customers is lower, but long-term value is not declining and market share is rising.

qa_highlights.question: Is DITA improving, and how many stores will be refurbished?
qa_highlights.answer: Q2 was the first quarter of overall revenue growth at DITA, and ADS decline is arrested. About 400 stores will get refurbishment, with about 100 done, targeted for completion in about three quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Why are Popeyes store margins lagging, and at what ADS are they expected to be reached?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited higher rentals as a fifth or sixth QSR player, store operating costs, and marketing leverage needed at scale. It targets ADS of near Rs 1 lakh, with the glide path visible.

qa_highlights.question: Why are Popeyes and Domino's co-located, and is it a program?
qa_highlights.answer: It is opportunistic, at 3-4 sites (e.g., Indiranagar, Marathahalli, Coimbatore), with better ROCE and shared fixed costs. Customer acceptance is still being assessed, and no program to open 100 such stores has been decided.

qa_highlights.question: Why does Turkey LFL remain negative while margins are held?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said transactions and prices are growing and the negative LFL reflects the accounting treatment of headline inflation. It said the company may try to disclose a figure excluding inflation.

risks_watch: Dairy, chicken and vegetable inflation: 60 bps of unplanned cost pressure remains unabsorbed, and management cited oil prices and the West Asia situation.
Turkey LFL remains negative, and management's accounting explanation may leave limited visibility into operating performance.
Popeyes store-level profitability is not yet at target; unit economics depend on ADS scaling toward Rs 1 lakh and on rental costs.
Festive-season demand (next 7-10 days and Christmas period) could shift quarter-level LFL by 100-200 bps.
Whether the co-located Domino's-Popeyes format earns customer acceptance and ROCE accretion.
summary.management_tone: Confident on gross margin and Domino's execution, but cautious on the pace of Popeyes expansion and on the full-year LFL target. Evasive on Q3 and festive-season trends, and on the Turkey LFL gap, which management attributes to accounting.
key_quotes: We have taken about 140 or 150 to 200 basis points of price increases, very calibrated through machine learning models versus taking blunt price increases.
Unfortunately, they have been hit by 200 basis points of unforeseen, unplanned costs very suddenly, but they have been able to absorb almost 140 basis points with all the action they have taken.

adds.what: Popeyes store network: about 100 stores today, guided 40-45 openings per year, path to ~250 stores (Rs 1,000 crore run rate)
Store refurbishment of about 400 Domino's stores (about 100 done); not new capacity

growth.why: Full-year Domino's LFL guided at 5-7% (Q3 in that range), with Popeyes targeting 40-45 openings a year toward 250 stores; backing is partial, relying on pricing, innovation, and market-share gains, while the brief gives no Q2 revenue or EBITDA figures and no hard capacity numbers beyond store counts.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Gross margin targeted to improve a further 200 bps, with about 140 bps of a 200 bps unplanned cost hit absorbed and about 60 bps still outstanding, plus 140-200 bps of price increases already taken.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Popeyes guided to 40-45 openings a year from about 100 stores toward 250 (Rs 1,000 crore run rate), though pace depends on real estate and supply chain build-out.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Full-year Domino's LFL guided at 5-7% with Q3 in that range, DITA revenue grew in Q2 for the first time, and MAU growth of about 25% versus MTU about 9% points to share gains.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No utilisation figure was given and no new plant or major capex was flagged; Popeyes is said not to be capital-constrained and co-located stores remain undecided at 3-4 sites.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management held the 5-7% full-year LFL target and said the next 7-10 days and Christmas could move the number by 100-200 bps, with no sign of raising guidance.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Management is cautious on the full-year LFL target and Popeyes expansion pace, with 60 bps of cost inflation unabsorbed and dairy, chicken and vegetable inflation still rising.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Innovation (Cheese Burst, Chicken Maxxx, Paneer Maxxx, Cold Coffee, Mousse Cakes) already adds almost double-digit contribution to top-line growth, and Coffy is repositioning with a cold-beverage portfolio, though no specific new launch dates were given.

rows.label: DITA revenue growth and store refurbishment
rows.why: Q2 was the first quarter of overall DITA revenue growth with ADS decline arrested, and about 100 of 400 Domino's stores are refurbished with completion expected in about three quarters.

rows.label: Popeyes store-level unit economics
rows.why: Store margins still lag on rentals, store operating costs, manpower and marketing, and ADS must scale toward Rs 1 lakh per store, with the glide path described as visible but no date given.

rows.label: Further price increases if inflation persists
rows.why: About 140-200 bps of price has been taken, and further hikes are possible given dairy, chicken and vegetable inflation tied to monsoon and West Asia costs.

tone.note: Management was confident on gross margin recovery and Domino's execution, but cautious on Popeyes expansion pace, unit economics and the full-year LFL target; analysts pressed on the Turkey LFL gap, Popeyes store margins and Q3 trends.
